name: Joint Special Meeting of the Urban Forest Advisory Committee and the Environmental Commission
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Joint Special Meeting of the Urban Forest Advisory Committee and the Environmental Commission
AGENDA
NOVEMBER 13, 2025 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
Environmental Commission: Commission Chair Cramer, Commission Vice Chair O'Connor, Commissioners Switzler, Parker, Wick, and Bruner. Urban Forestry Advisory Committee: Committee Chair Lefkowits, Committee Vice Chair Schneider, Committee Members Michelove, Altman, Gurnoe, Palumbo, and Jenne.
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker's slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
ACTION ITEMS
1.
Mature Tree Ordinance. Evan Jedynak, Senior Planner
For the Environmental Commission and the Urban Forest Advisory Committee (UFAC) to make a recommendation to staff on the mature tree ordinance (Attachment 1) that specifically addresses the four discrepancies between the draft ordinance and the UFAC revisions provided in an ordinance format discussed herein, along with any other recommendations.
Item 5A - Mature Tree Ordinance Staff Report
Item 5A - Attachment 1 - Draft Mature Tree Ordinance
Item 5A - Attachment 2 - UFAC Proposed Revision
Item 5A -Attachment 3 - Measurement Guide
6.
ADJOURNMENT
